request.subject: PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Replace only the tall curved chrome fin on top: it becomes a thin chrome antenna mast with a small glowing hot magenta orb on its tip. Keep the chrome hull, the glass dome, the magenta lights, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
